name: dsh-cockpit
description: DSH 驾驶舱套件：通过官方 agent/request-error 钩子覆盖 retryPolicy 的自动续轮、会话归档与空对话清理、输入框上方的「清理临时产物」按钮、下载进度、删除审计、孤儿附件清理、懒加载的会话统计、排查侧栏（推理强度滑条由独立的 dsh-effort-slider 提供）。 · Suite with official request-error retry-policy override, session archive and cleanup, a composer cleanup button, download progress, deletion audit, orphan-attachment cleanup, lazy session statistics, a diagnostics sidebar; the reasoning slider lives in the standalone dsh-effort-slider package.

scripts.check: node scripts/build-client.mjs --check && node --check host.js && node --check auto-continue.js && node --check stats.js && node --check client.js
scripts.test: node verify-cockpit.cjs && node verify-auto-continue.cjs && node verify-archive.cjs && node verify-client-ui.cjs && node verify-downloads.cjs && node verify-maintenance.cjs && node verify-stats.cjs && node verify-theme-tokens.cjs
